item.laowu.attack_breeding_cat_food.tool: Always inherits the better parental Combat Power Attribute plus 4 random attributes. If both corresponding Limits are at least 90, the child's value and Limit gain +1.
item.laowu.health_breeding_cat_food.tool: Always inherits the better parental Health Attribute plus 4 random attributes. If both corresponding Limits are at least 90, the child's value and Limit gain +1.

block.laowu.basic_breeding_box.tooltip.s: Insert two adult Cat Pancakes and breeding food to produce a kitten pancake after 2 minutes. Base mutation chance: 10%; no automation. Hold Shift in the breeding screen to view both parents' Attribute Limits.
block.laowu.intermediate_breeding_box.to: Insert two adult Cat Pancakes and breeding food to produce a kitten pancake after 1 minute 30 seconds. Base mutation chance: 15%; supports hopper input and output. Hold Shift in the breeding screen to view both parents' Attribute Limits.
block.laowu.advanced_breeding_box.toolti: Produces a kitten pancake after 1 minute with a 20% base mutation chance. Its top control selects Locked, replacement after every breeding cycle, or redstone-pulse replacement. Adjacent side containers supply parents ranked by Attribute Limits; Cat Filters can set targets, while an empty slot targets 100 in all six Limits. Hold Shift in the breeding screen to view Attribute Limits.
block.laowu.adoption_box.tooltip.summary: Holds up to 9 cat pancakes on the left. Cats are adopted within 1–2 minutes and leave villager-profession resources on the right; better attributes mean faster adoption and better rewards.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.mutation.title: Mutation Chance
gui.laowu.breeding_box.mutation.source: Source: the box's base chance plus Mutation Cat Food (20%), then increased by the parents' average Luck Attribute.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.mutation.attribut: Each uninherited attribute rolls separately; a success rerolls it once and keeps the result with the higher Limit.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.mutation.other: Each appearance region rolls separately; traits roll once and a success adds one compatible trait absent from both parents.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.title: Using the Breeding Box
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.insert: Use to insert: cat pancakes fill Father then Mother; breeding food enters the food slot.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.extract: Sneak-use to retrieve: kitten, food, mother, then father.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.start: With both parents, breeding food, and an empty child slot, breeding starts; completion consumes 1 food and creates a kitten pancake.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.shift: The screen shows Current Attributes by default; hold Shift to view Attribute Limits in dark-blue digits.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.attributes: Attributes: Current and Limit are always inherited together. Food selects the count; other attributes reroll. Stat food locks its named attribute; if both parental Limits are at least 90, the child's Current and Limit gain +1.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.traits: Traits: shared traits are guaranteed and each one-parent trait has a 50% chance. Offspring traits start at level I; Doughy is never inherited. Mutation may add one new trait.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.info.appearance: Appearance: every region independently inherits one parent's material and may mutate.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.level.title: Breeding Box Tier
gui.laowu.breeding_box.level.effect: Tier determines the box's base mutation chance and breeding duration.
gui.laowu.breeding_box.level.advanced_re: The Advanced Box's top control selects Locked, Automatic Replacement, or Redstone Activated. Replacement ranks Attribute Limits only; side Cat Filters can set targets, while an empty slot targets 100 in all six Limits.
item.laowu.terminator_suit.tooltip.summa: Turns a tamed cat into a Mechanical Cat: a steady, balanced ranged fighter that protects its owner and fires lasers from up to 16 blocks away.
item.laowu.terminator_suit.tooltip.behav: Combat Power Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+20_; Armor _+6_; Armor Toughness _+3_.
item.laowu.fishing_suit.tooltip.summary: Turns a tamed cat into a Fishing Cat. While seated on a Seat beside a container, it fishes in water adjacent to the block below the Seat; larger waters fish faster, and higher Luck improves the loot.
item.laowu.fishing_suit.tooltip.behaviou: Luck Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+20_; Armor _+5_; Armor Toughness _+2_.
item.laowu.flight_suit.tooltip.summary: Turns a tamed cat into a Pilot Cat. In combat it circles at low altitude, then dives for a powerful melee strike; sneak-use it to open its 27-slot portable inventory.
item.laowu.flight_suit.tooltip.behaviour: Completes one dive attack every _max(20, 36 - 0.10 × Speed) ticks_.
Combat Power Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+12_; Armor _+3_; Armor Toughness _+1_.
item.laowu.fire_suit.tooltip.summary: Turns a tamed cat into a Flamethrower Cat that breathes a short cone of fire at nearby enemies and keeps adjacent Blaze Burners kindled without fuel while seated.
item.laowu.fire_suit.tooltip.behaviour3: Stamina Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+40_; Armor _+10_; Armor Toughness _+4_.
item.laowu.honey_suit.tooltip.summary: Turns a tamed cat into a Honey-Gathering Cat. While seated, it raises the honey level of the hive below every 10 seconds; in combat, it slowly fires honey missiles that inflict Slowness II for 3 seconds.
item.laowu.honey_suit.tooltip.behaviour3: Speed Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+24_; Armor _+5_; Armor Toughness _+2_.
item.laowu.transport_suit.tooltip.summar: Turns a tamed cat into a Logistics Cat. While seated, it acts as a package container between matching addresses; while standing, it does not attack and approaches same-owner career cats in combat that have not collected all five logistics buffs.
item.laowu.transport_suit.tooltip.behavi: Each cardboard parcel adds one missing effect from Strength, Speed, Resistance, Regeneration, or Fire Resistance. One cat may hold all _five_ simultaneously; each lasts _20 seconds_.

From 0 to 100 Intelligence, search range rises from _8_ to _16 blocks_, casting range from _6_ to _10 blocks_, and support interval falls from _10_ to _6 seconds_; movement and decisions become faster, with greater priority given to wounded allies.
Speed Attribute _+10_; Extra Health _+30_; Armor _+6_; Armor Toughness _+3_.
item.laowu.dynamite_suit.tooltip.summary: Turns a tamed cat into a Dynamite Cat. Within 8 blocks it throws dynamite that deals heavy area damage to enemies, but attacks slowly. When fatally wounded, it locks itself at 1 health, charges an enemy, and self-destructs at close range.
item.laowu.dynamite_suit.tooltip.behavio: _135%% × (2 + 0.08 × Combat Power)_; the fatal self-destruct deals _10×_ this result.

trait.laowu.low_level_code.title: Low-Level Code
trait.laowu.low_level_code.description: Chases nearby moving minecarts and becomes a Cat Pancake on collision.
trait.laowu.shedding.title: Shedding
trait.laowu.shedding.description: Seeks nearby running belts and drops one Cat Fur every three minutes while standing on one.
trait.laowu.stitch.title: Stitch
trait.laowu.stitch.description: Treats the nearest living creature within 12 blocks as an attack target.
trait.laowu.xiaoting.title: Xiaoting
trait.laowu.xiaoting.description: Drops 1 extra random smithing template on death; has a 20% chance to give another with a morning gift.
trait.laowu.doraemon.title: Doraemon
trait.laowu.doraemon.summary: More likely to give rare gifts
trait.laowu.doraemon.description: Whenever a morning gift triggers, has a 35% chance to give one additional rare item.
trait.laowu.edward.title: Edward
trait.laowu.edward.description: Drops one Cat Fur every three minutes and actively attacks sleeping players within 16 blocks.
trait.laowu.cat_king.title: Cat King
trait.laowu.cat_king.description: Continuously plays random Minecraft records nearby; only the three nearest Cat Kings play at once.
trait.laowu.ding_dong_cat.title: Ding-Dong Cat
trait.laowu.ding_dong_cat.description: Leaves a snow layer on valid empty ground it walks over; controlled by mobGriefing.
trait.laowu.code_conflict.title: Code Conflict
trait.laowu.code_conflict.description: When hissing, touching fluid or being splashed by a potion ends the hiss and makes the cat flee briefly.
trait.laowu.food_guard.title: Food Guarding
trait.laowu.food_guard.description: Attacks any creature that approaches a food item lying in front of it.
trait.laowu.mischievous.title: Meddlesome
trait.laowu.mischievous.description: Only deals one point of probing damage to creatures near block edges, then pushes them hard toward the ledge.
trait.laowu.filicide.title: Filicide
trait.laowu.filicide.description: Actively attacks kittens within 12 blocks and deals double damage to them.
trait.laowu.drowning.title: Drowning
trait.laowu.drowning.description: Cannot maintain buoyancy in water, slowing down and sinking instead.
trait.laowu.cable_biter.title: Cable Biter
trait.laowu.cable_biter.description: Periodically chews redstone components within three blocks; controlled by mobGriefing.
trait.laowu.air_raid_siren.title: Air-Raid Siren
trait.laowu.air_raid_siren.description: Makes this cat the hissing sound source and plays two audio layers for a clearly louder hiss.
trait.laowu.minor_illness.title: A Little Ill
trait.laowu.minor_illness.description: On death, sets all six base attributes and their limits to zero.
trait.laowu.cuddle_only.title: Cuddles Only
trait.laowu.cuddle_only.description: Cannot enter love mode with food or act as a parent in natural breeding or a Breeding Box.
trait.laowu.selected_elder.title: Select Elder
trait.laowu.selected_elder.summary: Hisses on sight; attacks its target when hurt; Combat Power Attribute +%s
trait.laowu.selected_elder.description: Selects and hisses at any creature within five blocks; when hurt, attacks the currently selected target; Combat Power Attribute +%s.
trait.laowu.selected_elder.next: Next level: Combat Power Attribute +%s; target selection, hissing, and retaliation are unchanged.
trait.laowu.tom_tree_feller.title: TOM the Lumberjack
trait.laowu.tom_tree_feller.description: Continuously breaks logs or wood directly below it; controlled by mobGriefing.
trait.laowu.hunter_kimi.title: Hunter Kimi
trait.laowu.hunter_kimi.description: Hunts nearby chickens, rabbits, and fish, then stores edible drops in its own inventory.
trait.laowu.high_step.title: High-Step Cat
trait.laowu.high_step.summary: Can step onto very high ledges
trait.laowu.high_step.description: Can step directly onto ledges up to three blocks high without an extra jump.
trait.laowu.sky_cat.title: Sky Cat
trait.laowu.sky_cat.description: Uses smooth, Phantom-like inertial flight and circles near itself or its owner.
trait.laowu.auto_attach.title: Auto-Attach
trait.laowu.auto_attach.description: When a player within 12 blocks attacks, rapidly closes on that player's target for up to three seconds.
trait.laowu.tripod_cat.title: Three-Legged Cat
trait.laowu.tripod_cat.description: Finds foot-slot equipment in nearby containers, steals one piece, and stores it in its own inventory.
trait.laowu.high_explosive_fuel.title: High-Explosive Fuel
trait.laowu.high_explosive_fuel.summary: Ignites mobs and empowers pancake blasts
trait.laowu.high_explosive_fuel.descript: While wearing the Fire Suit, ignites creatures in a 3x3x3 area. Its Cat Pancake deals a larger blast when fired by a Cat Cannon or dispenser.
trait.laowu.rolling_log.title: Rolling Log
trait.laowu.rolling_log.description: Continuously remains invisible without displaying potion particles.
trait.laowu.loli.title: LOLI
trait.laowu.loli.description: Permanently remains a kitten and cannot be grown with Cat Food.
trait.laowu.him.title: him
trait.laowu.him.description: Both eyes become glowing white and ignore ambient light.
trait.laowu.isaac.title: Isaac
trait.laowu.isaac.description: Gains visible tear streaks and continuously sheds tears.
trait.laowu.round_head.title: Round Head
trait.laowu.round_head.description: Both ears disappear during combat and return after disengaging.
trait.laowu.oiiai.title: oiiai
trait.laowu.oiiai.description: The complete cat model continuously spins around itself.
trait.laowu.rainbow_cat.title: Rainbow Cat
trait.laowu.rainbow_cat.summary: Rainbow skin and trail; Speed attribute +%s, Luck attribute +%s
trait.laowu.rainbow_cat.description: Its skin becomes rainbow-coloured and leaves a six-colour trail while moving; Speed attribute +%s and Luck attribute +%s.
trait.laowu.nekomata.title: Nekomata
trait.laowu.nekomata.summary: Two tails; Combat attribute +%s, Intelligence attribute +%s
trait.laowu.nekomata.description: Two tails spread left and right from one shared root and animate together; Combat attribute +%s and Intelligence attribute +%s.
trait.laowu.puss_in_boots.title: Puss in Boots
trait.laowu.puss_in_boots.description: Wears a brown boot on every paw; all four follow the live leg animation.
trait.laowu.big_chonky_cat.title: Big Chonky Cat
trait.laowu.big_chonky_cat.description: Model, collision box, and eye height all scale to %s%%.
item.laowu.butter_bread.tooltip: Use on an untamed cat to summon a giant Butter Bread and turn it into a Butter Cat that inherits its material.
tooltip.laowu.material_debug_wand.cat: Right-click a cat: choose a whole or regional material
tooltip.laowu.material_debug_wand.block: Right-click a block: sample and export it as a cat material
gui.laowu.cat_material_editor.hint: Click a central name to cycle forward
